descriptor: Small broad-rounded ornamental; deep pink-red spring blossom; dark green (maroon-flushed new growth); golden-bronze fall; persistent small red crabapples; scaly reddish bark.
identityNotes: Modeled on Malus 'Prairifire', the dominant disease-resistant ornamental cultivar in the St. Louis region (MoBot Plant Finder). If actual park trees are another cv., genus-level traits (broad-rounded habit, spring blossom, small persistent pomes) still hold. SMALL tree (~6 m) — the ornamental-chassis gap.

referenceImages.caption: Broad-rounded habit, dark green summer foliage; authoritative cultivar profile (pull the spring-bloom plate here).
referenceImages.credit: Missouri Botanical Garden Plant Finder — Malus 'Prairifire'

referenceImages.caption: Golden-bronze fall foliage with persistent purplish-red fruit clusters.
